{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection1","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    private const string TestSource = \"\"\"\n        using MessagePack;\n\n        namespace TempProject\n        {\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public class MyObject\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public MyEnum Value { get; set; }\n            }\n\n            public enum MyEnum\n            {\n                A = 0,\n                B = 1,\n            }\n        }\n        \"\"\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_OmitsExcludeFromCodeCoverage_ForNetStandard20AndNetFramework()\n    {\n        await AssertEnumFormatterExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(\"NETSTANDARD2_0\", expectExcludeFromCodeCoverage: false);\n        await AssertEnumFormatterExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(\"NETFRAMEWORK\", expectExcludeFromCodeCoverage: false);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_IncludesExcludeFromCodeCoverage_ForNetStandard21AndModernNet()\n    {\n        await AssertEnumFormatterExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(\"NETSTANDARD2_1\", expectExcludeFromCodeCoverage: true);\n        await AssertEnumFormatterExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(\"NET6_0\", expectExcludeFromCodeCoverage: true);\n        await AssertEnumFormatterExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(\"NET8_0\", expectExcludeFromCodeCoverage: true);\n    }\n\n    private static async Task AssertEnumFormatterExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(string preprocessorSymbol, bool expectExcludeFromCodeCoverage)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        MetadataReference[] references = net80Refs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(\n            LanguageVersion.Latest,\n            preprocessorSymbols: new[] { preprocessorSymbol });\n\n        SyntaxTree inputTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(TestSource, parseOptions);\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            $\"TestAssembly_{preprocessorSymbol}\",\n            new[] { inputTree },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new ISourceGenerator[] { new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(\n            compilation,\n            out Compilation outputCompilation,\n            out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        ClassDeclarationSyntax? enumFormatterClass = null;\n        SyntaxTree? enumFormatterTree = null;\n        foreach (SyntaxTree tree in outputCompilation.SyntaxTrees)\n        {\n            if (tree == inputTree)\n            {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            ClassDeclarationSyntax? candidate = tree.GetRoot()\n                .DescendantNodes()\n                .OfType<ClassDeclarationSyntax>()\n                .FirstOrDefault(c => c.Identifier.ValueText.Contains(\"MyEnumFormatter\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n            if (candidate != null)\n            {\n                enumFormatterClass = candidate;\n                enumFormatterTree = tree;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        Assert.NotNull(enumFormatterTree);\n        Assert.NotNull(enumFormatterClass);\n\n        SemanticModel semanticModel = outputCompilation.GetSemanticModel(enumFormatterTree!);\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterSymbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(enumFormatterClass!);\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterSymbol);\n\n        bool hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage = formatterSymbol!.GetAttributes().Any(attr =>\n            string.Equals(\n                attr.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString(),\n                \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\",\n                StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        Assert.Equal(expectExcludeFromCodeCoverage, hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage);\n    }\n}\n"}
